# togetherai Provider

Community provider for [Together AI](https://www.together.ai) infrastructure: GPU clusters with shared storage, and dedicated inference endpoints with their deployments and traffic split. It is not affiliated with Together AI.

This is an early release (v0.x): resource schemas and behaviour may change between minor versions.

The API key is checked when a resource or data source calls the API, so `terraform validate` and plans with nothing to read work without one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    togetherai = {
      source = "the-devops-daily/togetherai"
    }
  }
}

# Reads TOGETHER_API_KEY (and optional TOGETHER_PROJECT_ID) from the
# environment. Never put the key in a .tf file.
provider "togetherai" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Together AI API key. Can also be set with the `TOGETHER_API_KEY` environment variable. GPU cluster kubeconfigs are only returned to keys of a project admin.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Together AI API. Defaults to `https://api.together.ai`. Can also be set with the `TOGETHER_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `project_id` (String) Default project for dedicated endpoints and deployments (the `/v2/projects/{projectId}` APIs). Can also be set with the `TOGETHER_PROJECT_ID` environment variable. When it is not set and the key can see exactly one project, that project is used.
